title: Integrated analysis of transcriptomics and network pharmacology reveals the therapeutic mechanism of cedrol in IBD.
authors: Diao, Haiyang; Qin, Tonghui; Zheng, Yifei; Han, Linlin; Zhao, Yuqing
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究姜中活性成分雪松醇对炎症性肠病的治疗机制，采用转录组学与网络药理学分析，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Previous studies have reported that ginger (Zingiber officinale) and its extracts (or components such as gingerols) can alleviate inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). Herein, we report the evaluation of Cedrol (CE), a bioactive compound from ginger, for its therapeutic potential in IBD-an application that, to our knowledge, has not been previously investigated. PURPOSE: This study aims to investigate the therapeutic effects and underlying mechanisms of CE in the treatment of IBD. METHODS: In vitro experiments were conducted using LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophages, while in vivo studies employed a DSS-induced acute murine model of IBD. The intestinal protective effects of CE and its multi-target regulatory mechanisms were systematically elucidated by integrating network pharmacology prediction with transcriptomic analysis, and further validated using ELISA, Western blotting, qPCR, cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), and immunofluorescence in both in vitro and in vivo models. RESULT: CE significantly ameliorated DSS-induced colitis in mice, as demonstrated by a reduced disease activity index (DAI), attenuated colon shortening, and improved histopathological scores. In LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophages, CE suppressed the production of pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-1beta, IL-6, TNF-alpha), decreased MDA levels, and enhanced antioxidant defenses, including superoxide dismutase (SOD), T-AOC, and the GSH/GSSG ratio. Integrated transcriptomic and network pharmacology analyses identified 15 overlapping targets between CE and IBD, with significant enrichment in the JAK/STAT and NF-kappaB signaling pathways. Molecular docking and cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA) confirmed direct binding of CE to COX-2 and HIF-1alpha. Furthermore, CE downregulated phosphorylation of JAK3/STAT3, reduced the expression of COX-2 and HIF-1alpha, and restored intestinal barrier integrity by upregulating the tight junction proteins ZO-1 and occludin, while downregulating claudin-2. CONCLUSION: CE exerts significant protective effects against experimental colitis through a multi-target mechanism, involving suppression of the JAK3/STAT3 signaling pathway, modulation of NF-kappaB-mediated inflammation, and downregulation of COX-2 and HIF-1alpha expression. These actions collectively attenuate intestinal inflammation, reduce oxidative stress, and enhance gut barrier integrity by restoring tight junction proteins (ZO-1, occludin, claudin-2). Collectively, CE represents a promising natural agent for the management of IBD.
abstract_zh: 背景：既往研究报道，姜（Zingiber officinale）及其提取物（或如姜辣素等成分）可缓解炎症性肠病（IBD）。在此，我们报告对姜中一种生物活性化合物雪松醇（CE）在IBD中治疗潜力的评估——据我们所知，该应用此前尚未被研究。目的：本研究旨在探讨CE治疗IBD的治疗效果及其潜在机制。方法：体外实验使用LPS刺激的RAW264.7巨噬细胞进行，而体内研究采用DSS诱导的急性小鼠IBD模型。通过整合网络药理学预测与转录组分析，系统阐明CE的肠道保护作用及其多靶点调控机制，并进一步在体外和体内模型中使用ELISA、Western blotting、qPCR、细胞热位移分析（CETSA）和免疫荧光进行验证。结果：CE显著改善DSS诱导的小鼠结肠炎，表现为疾病活动指数（DAI）降低、结肠缩短减轻及组织病理学评分改善。在LPS刺激的RAW264.7巨噬细胞中，CE抑制促炎细胞因子（IL-1β、IL-6、TNF-α）的产生，降低MDA水平，并增强抗氧化防御，包括超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、总抗氧化能力（T-AOC）及GSH/GSSG比值。整合转录组和网络药理学分析确定了CE与IBD之间的15个重叠靶点，并在JAK/STAT和NF-κB信号通路中显著富集。分子对接和细胞热位移分析（CETSA）确认CE直接结合COX-2和HIF-1α。此外，CE下调JAK3/STAT3的磷酸化，降低COX-2和HIF-1α的表达，并通过上调紧密连接蛋白ZO-1和occludin、下调claudin-2来恢复肠道屏障完整性。结论：CE通过多靶点机制对实验性结肠炎发挥显著保护作用，涉及抑制JAK3/STAT3信号通路、调节NF-κB介导的炎症以及下调COX-2和HIF-1α表达。这些作用共同减轻肠道炎症、降低氧化应激，并通过恢复紧密连接蛋白（ZO-1、occludin、claudin-2）增强肠道屏障完整性。总体而言，CE代表了一种有前景的IBD管理天然药物。
